option.value:
Generate a Git commit message in the Conventional Commits format based on the following staged changes:
Subject line should be in imperative mood, max 50 characters, and not end with a period. Separate subject from body with a blank line. Body should explain "what" and "why", wrapped at 72 characters.
[Provide the output of `git diff --staged` here]
Context/Motivation: [Briefly explain the purpose of these changes, e.g., "Implementing a new feature for user profile management," or "Fixing a bug in the login flow."]

task.summary: Default task

feat: enhance homepage layout and styles
Added a new responsive container component to optimize layout management. Updated homepage with improved structure, typography, and quick links for easier navigation. Updated color variables for better theme consistency. These changes enhance the user experience and align with the project's design goals.

feat: update the navigation list
- update the hover color to the accent color - increase the gap between each navigation link item

feat: restructure homepage and navigation
- Split homepage into modular sections for better readability and scalability (Intro, Work, Blog, Shots, Contact). - Replaced the old navigation list with a new dedicated Nav component. - Implemented smooth scrolling for hash links. - Added Framer Motion animations for enhanced scrolling experience. - Updated layout context to support dynamic section registrations.
feat: Add call-to-action to home page intro section

feat: Redesign homepage layout with new grid and components (17102025)
Introduces a comprehensive redesign of the homepage, implementing a new CSS grid system and refactored components for a more structured and visually appealing layout.
- Implemented a CSS grid-based layout system with new utility classes (`section`, `content`, `app-margin`, `dashboard-card`) in globals.css. - Consolidated and removed deprecated section components (BlogSection, ContactSection, ShotsSection). - Refactored IntroSection to Intro and ProjectsSection to RecentProjects, integrating them with the new grid for a dashboard-like overview. - Migrated icon library from `lucide-react` to `@phosphor-icons/react`, updating relevant files and Next.js configuration for optimization. - Aligned header and navigation components with the new margin variables and grid structure for consistent spacing.

feat(ui): Implement responsive layout and enhance header (17102025)
Refactor and enhance the application's user interface and layout.
- Introduce a new responsive grid system and layout utilities in `app/globals.css`. This includes responsive `app-margin`, `grid--app-columns`, and `content` utilities, which are now applied to the `.section` component for consistent layout. - Extract `Hamburger` and `Logo` components into dedicated `ui` modules, simplifying the `Header` component and removing the `hamburger-react` dependency. - Enhance the `RecentProjects` section with a new tech stack display featuring SVG icons (Flutter, Dart, React, Kotlin, Firebase, Next.js) and an updated responsive grid layout for dashboard cards. - Adjust `Intro` component text for improved clarity. - Update `next.config.ts` to allow SVG image imports. - Minor styling adjustments to `.button-primary` padding.

feat(layout): Implement new grid system and dynamic background (17102025)
Refactor core UI layout, introduce a dynamic background, and begin Contentful integration.
- Implemented a new 36-column CSS grid system in `app/globals.css` applied to `intro.tsx`, `app/projects/page.tsx`, and `recent-projects.tsx` for consistent layout. - Added a `WarpBackground` component for a dynamic visual effect, integrated into `app/layout.tsx`. - Initiated Contentful integration: added necessary packages, GraphQL query (`app/graphql/get-projects.ts`), custom types (`type.d.ts`), and updated `next.config.ts` for image domains. - Extracted GitHub contributions graph into a dedicated component, `app/components/github-contributions-graph.tsx`, improving modularity. - Applied minor styling adjustments to `nav.tsx` and `logo.tsx`. - Updated `intro.tsx` text sizes for improved responsiveness.

feat(intro): Implement loading sequence and phased content reveal (17102025)
- Introduce an `introDone` state in `LayoutContext` to manage the completion of the initial loading animation. - Refactor `WarpBackground` to include a phased intro animation: displaying an initial text, then animating a wave-like reveal of the background dots. This component sets `introDone` to true upon completion. - Conditionally render `Nav` and `Header` components, and animate their entry using Framer Motion, ensuring they appear only after the intro. - Update `LayoutWrapper` to control the main content's fade-in based on the `introDone` state, with an extended transition duration. - This enhances the initial user experience with a smoother, animated loading sequence.

feat(scroll): Implement smooth scrolling and active section tracking (17102025)
Refactor `LayoutContext` to manage active sections and provide a smooth scroll function using `IntersectionObserver` and Framer Motion.
- Update `config/site.ts` to use hash links for navigation items. - Introduce `activeSection` state and `IntersectionObserver` in `LayoutContext` to accurately track the currently visible section. - Refine `scrollToSection` to smoothly animate scrolling to target sections, accounting for header offset and preventing observer interference during programmatic scrolls. - Register `Intro` and new `Projects` components as scrollable sections, including cleanup on unmount. - Integrate the `Projects` component into `app/page.tsx`. - Update `Nav` and `MobileMenu` to highlight the `activeSection` and utilize the new `scrollToSection` functionality for navigation.

feat: Enhance typography and redesign projects section (17102025)
Introduce Neue Montreal and Inter fonts, updating global font variables and applying new typography settings for the body. The Intro component was refactored to use updated font classes for improved consistency. The main layout now uses Satoshi's className instead of its variable.
The Projects component was redesigned to feature a dynamic list of projects, including titles, briefs, and tools, utilizing the new Neue Montreal font for headings.
Additionally, the base opacity of the warp background was adjusted for a subtle visual refinement.
feat(intro): change font weight of main intro header text and `h1` tag of the summary to `p`

feat(projects, ui): Implement dynamic project pages and enhance fonts (17102025)
Introduces dynamic project detail pages and refines typography across the application.
- Added dynamic routing for project details at `app/projects/[slug]/`. - Moved project data to `lib/fake-projects.ts` for better structure. - Updated `app/components/projects.tsx` to link to detail pages and applied new styling. - Removed the deprecated `app/projects/page.tsx` file. - Enhanced `config/fonts.ts` to support multiple weights for Neue Montreal font and set it as the primary app font. - Adjusted font weights and sizes in `app/components/intro.tsx` to align with the new typography system. - Improved navigation in `components/nav.tsx` to highlight active project routes.

feat(contentful, projects): Integrate Contentful for project data (17102025)
Configured Apollo Client to connect to Contentful GraphQL API, enabling dynamic fetching of project data.
- Updated `app/graphql/get-projects.ts` to fetch project summaries optimized for list display. - Implemented dynamic project fetching in `app/components/projects.tsx` using `useSuspenseQuery`, replacing static `fakeProjects` data. - Introduced `Project` and `ProjectItemT` types in `type.d.ts` to align with Contentful data structure. - Added a loading skeleton for the project list for improved user experience. - Refined project item display, including a structured list for tools.

feat(projects, contentful, ui): Implement dynamic project detail pages (17102025)
This commit replaces static project data with dynamic content fetched from Contentful, significantly enhancing the project detail pages.
- Integrated Contentful GraphQL API to fetch individual project details using a new `GET_PROJECT` query. - Refactored `app/projects/[slug]/page.tsx` to display dynamic content, including rich text descriptions, key features, images, and links. - Introduced `@radix-ui/react-slot` dependency for UI components. - Added `BackButton` and `ProjectLinkIcon` components for improved UX. - Updated `type.d.ts` to reflect Contentful's `linksCollection` and `galleryCollection` structure. - Applied minor styling adjustments in `app/globals.css`, including card background and grid layout refinements. - Implemented dynamic metadata generation for project detail pages.

feat(projects, routing): Implement dedicated projects page (17102025)
Migrate project listings from the homepage to a new dedicated '/projects' route, enhancing navigation and content organization.
- Introduce a new `/projects` page with its own layout and dynamic project listing, replacing the previous homepage section. - Refactor the existing `Projects` component into `ProjectsList` and `ProjectItem` components for better modularity and reusability. - Update navigation links in `config/site.ts` to reflect the new routing structure. - Improve the layout and responsiveness of individual project detail pages (`/projects/[slug]`), including a refined grid system and component styling. - Adjust global CSS and navigation component for consistency with the new project structure.

feat(projects): Implement interactive project gallery (17102025)
Refactor project image gallery into a new dedicated component to improve modularity and user experience.
- Create `ProjectGallery` component at `app/projects/_components/`. - Migrate gallery rendering logic from `app/projects/[slug]/page.tsx` to the new `ProjectGallery` component. - Integrate Radix UI `Dialog` and Embla Carousel for full-screen interactive image viewing. - Add new dependencies: `@radix-ui/react-dialog`, `@radix-ui/react-visually-hidden`, `embla-carousel-react`, and `lucide-react`. - Adjust `h1` text size on project detail pages.

refactor(components): Streamline component structure and navigation (17102025)
Refactor core components to improve modularity, simplify navigation, and standardize component organization.
- Move `Intro`, `RecentProjects`, and `GithubContributionGraph` components from `app/components/` to `app/_components/` to establish a convention for internal or private components. - Extract layout registration and section wrapping logic from `Intro` component to `app/page.tsx`, simplifying `Intro`'s responsibilities. - Update `Intro`'s main heading size from `xl:text-8xl` to `xl:text-9xl`. - Rename `Home` page component to `HomePage` in `app/page.tsx`. - Remove scroll-based active section tracking and smooth scrolling functionality from `Nav` component, simplifying its logic and relying on Next.js pathname for active link highlighting.

feat(homepage): Dynamic hero, personas, and work experience section (17102025)
- Refactor `Intro` component to fetch dynamic content from Contentful, enabling a persona-driven display with rich text rendering. - Introduce `GET_HERO` GraphQL query and TypeScript types (`Persona`, `Hero`) for Contentful integration. - Add a new "Work Experience" section to the homepage, showcasing placeholder job roles and durations using UI cards. - Update global CSS with a new `ringed-card` utility, custom scrollbar styles, and a refined dark theme background color.

feat(works): Rename projects to works and enhance portfolio section (17102025)
- Renamed all 'Projects' related routes, components, and GraphQL queries to 'Works' for improved clarity and consistency. - Introduced `lib/date-formatter.ts` for consistent date formatting across the application. - Added new UI components: `Spinner` and `Skeleton` for better loading state feedback. - Implemented dedicated loading states for both the works list and individual work detail pages. - Refactored the homepage to integrate a new `RecentWorks` component, dynamically showcasing recent projects and replacing the prior static 'Work Experience' section. - Updated `config/site.ts` to reflect the new 'Works' navigation link. - Enhanced `app/globals.css` with a new `hovered-ringed-card` utility for improved interactive styling. - Adjusted `type.d.ts` to align with the new `Work` data structure, including `toolsShort`, `role`, `startDate`, and `endDate` fields.

feat(works): Display client info and refine work item details (17102025)
- Renamed `app/works/_components/works-item.tsx` to `work-item.tsx`. - Updated `app/works/_components/works-list.tsx` to reflect the component rename. - Added `client` field to the `Work` GraphQL query in `app/graphql/get-works.ts`. - Included `client` in the `WorkItemT` type definition in `type.d.ts`. - Displayed the `client` alongside the `role` in the `WorkItem` component. - Enhanced `lib/date-formatter.ts` to include short month names in date ranges.

refactor(ui, works): refine layout and standardize styling (17102025)
This commit introduces a comprehensive overhaul of styling and layout across the works section and core UI components to achieve a more cohesive and modern design.
Key changes include: - Standardized `Card` components to use `rounded-none` for a sharper look. - Replaced `gap` based grid layouts with `border` based layouts in `WorksList` and `WorkGallery` for a cleaner separation. - Removed redundant horizontal separator `span` elements from `Works` and `RecentWorks` pages. - Enhanced `WorkItem` component with conditional borders based on position within the grid, and refined text sizing. - Adjusted spacing and removed unnecessary vertical separators on individual work detail pages. - Updated `BackButton` styling to match the new `rounded-none` aesthetic.

feat(ui): Implement scroll fade for persona list (17102025)
This commit introduces a horizontal scroll fade effect for the persona selection list, enhancing usability and visual cues when the list overflows its container.
Key updates include: - Added interactive left and right fade gradients to the persona list. - Implemented scroll and resize event listeners to dynamically manage fade visibility based on scroll position. - Refined persona list styling to ensure horizontal scrolling and proper display of fade effects. - Adjusted typography for persona descriptions, increasing base font size for better readability on smaller screens. - Updated card heights and padding for both engineer and non-engineer persona views, improving overall layout responsiveness. - Modified unselected persona link color for improved contrast.

feat(ui): Improve responsiveness and typography (17102025)
Adjusted typography in the intro component, enhancing line height and font sizing for better readability on medium screens.
Updated mobile menu visibility to be hidden only on large screens, making it accessible on medium screens.

feat(ui): Enhance works section responsiveness and typography (17102025)
Adjusted grid layout in WorksList to be single column on small screens and two columns on medium screens. Refined typography for WorkItem elements (title, role, client, brief, tools) to improve readability across devices. Updated work range placement for consistent visibility and optimized layout.
